periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique inward orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated ovals with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the lower boundary extending significantly further from the geometric center than the upper boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape curve along the posterior edge of the dark band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band occupies approximately 30% of the visible torso length at the lateral flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide spacing between the ears, with the gap measuring roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: High degree of curvature resulting in smooth, rounded semicircular tops.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-rufous staining on the fur of the lower abdomen and hind-limb regions.
